geometry_authorship: New single-source seven-region total reconstruction: northwest library, north altar hall, northeast chest chamber, central statue courtyard, southwest four-column flooded hall, southeast pottery workshop, south gateway/dock, linked by bent passages and central bridge. Prior room geometry not used. QA harnesses reused.

native_palette_template_and_entities.scope: Actual vanilla Minecraft NBT decoder, registries, block entity loading, written-book parser, and StructureTemplate roundtrip. Not a world placement or gameplay test.

placement.world_anchor: User-chosen [X,Y,Z]; not placed by this task.
placement.formula: Place each part at world_anchor + origin, zero rotation, no mirror, integrity1.0.
placement.air_strategy: All source voxels including outside footprints and roof air are explicit. Place air as air (do not ignore air/use structure_void); every part fully overwrites its own box including terrain. No terrain is changed here.
placement.temporary_boundary_effects: Install complete set before judging fluid/plant boundary behavior; no game scheduler, placement or update ticks tested.

native_fragment_templates.scope: Vanilla 1.20.1 decoder, dense per-part local positions, block entity local loading and StructureTemplate roundtrip. Exact all-state/property/payload source reassembly in split-check.json. No world placement or ticks.

source_body_routes.scope: Native vanilla collision AABBs, dry support, body footprint; five horizontal samples per half-step at higher foot plane. No jumping, physics ticks or gameplay.

fragile_canSurvive_and_neighbor_shapes.scope: Vanilla 1.20.1 canSurvive and six-direction updateShape for wall/ceiling cave vines, waterlogged roots/slabs, fences, chain, lilies and pots using in-memory LevelAccessor. Scheduled fluid ticks are counted and suppressed, not executed. No world, random/fluid ticks, propagation scheduler, gameplay or deployment.

container_lid_water_support_leaves_and_r.scope: Static actual source states and entities; world ticks, fluid propagation, GUI opening and physics NOT_RUN.

actual_full_source_views_and_cutaway.renderer: Actual dense full-source NBT / Lodestone ThreeStructureRenderer / Edge WebGL; camera-only injection, no visual or geometry substitution. Regional screenshots all use the same uncut full source.

deviations: 73x22x73 image-proportioned original reconstruction, not a measured blueprint; five distinct chambers plus courtyard and entrance, all one floor with a one-step chest dais.
Open-top ruins, actual full source has no complete roof. Wall cap timbers/stone kept. No upper gallery inferred from picture.
Reference wet floors reconstructed as contained shallow pools and dry stone crossing paths; entrance dock and central bridge use full planks at common foot plane, not raised slabs.
Closed doors absent in source and reference: gateway is permanently open. No door-open substitute or changed collision source used.
All containers deliberately empty with no LootTable; no awarded or generated treasure claimed.
No external swamp biome forest/fog, custom shader reflection, hidden underground levels or waterfall invented. Moss textures are seeded vanilla brick mixes.
Block-built low altar, courtyard statue and four hall pillars approximate reference sculpted objects. No mobs, armor stands, commands or spawners.
Support substrates below separate room footprints are deliberate installation foundations; surrounding unused volume is explicit air and must clear old terrain when placing fragments.
